name: The Living Flow
source: A story about an alternate existence where there are multiple universes (dimensions; multiverse). All humans live in the communal realm and very few can travel to their own birth realm. Each human is born in their own realm called the birth realm and no one can travel to another person's realm.  Demons actively hunt humans to destroy or gain control over the immense power that each individual has.  These powers are as unique to each person as their birth realm.  Only a handful of humans can access this power and they are called Binders. The story follows a newly born human, Gene, who seems very weak and is constantly filled with fear and insecurities.
translation: 一个存在多重宇宙（维度）的另类世界。所有人类都生活在公共领域，只有极少数人能前往自己的出生领域。每个人都出生于独属于自己的出生领域，没有人能进入他人的领域。恶魔积极猎杀人类，试图摧毁或控制每个人拥有的巨大力量。这些力量与出生领域一样独一无二。只有少数人能使用这种力量，他们被称为Binder。故事讲述新生人类吉恩，他看似十分弱小，内心也一直充满恐惧与不安。
